body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> HP presented its HD digital camcorder HP 'V5040u' during Showstoppers at CES 2010, which has HDMI interface and features motion detection and up to 12MP still image capture.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
